source: After applying the board: 28 recipe links, 18 name merges, 5 dishes closed

sections.title: Quantities still to settle
sections.intro: Nine lines, all compared raw-against-raw so the cooked-versus-dry question is out of the way. Eleven of the twenty comparable lines now agree — Penne, Fusilli, Gnocchi, Farfalle, Broccoli IQF, Parsnip, Edamame, Spring Greens and Sugar Snap among them, most of them to the second decimal. These nine are what is left.

sections.title: Ingredients being bought that we may actually make
sections.intro: Each of these goes onto the raw-materials list under a name that says it has already been cooked or mixed — “Cavolo Nero, cooked”, “Verde Sauce”. If we make them, they need a short recipe so the real ingredients flow through to ordering. If we buy them ready, they are fine as they are and can be left.

sections.title: Decisions — James
sections.intro: One thing that needs a call rather than a fact.

items.title: Carrot Diced, IQF
items.evidence: Sheet 8.53 kg · app 0.23 kg — the app is 8.3 kg lower (97%). Both are RAW purchase weight, compared like for like. By far the biggest gap left. The app only uses diced carrot in two places — Marinara Sauce and New Gravy — at very small ratios. Your sheet asks for 8.53 kg. Something on OVEN 1 is consuming diced carrot that the app has no record of. Which mix or dish is it?

items.title: Orzo
items.evidence: Sheet 3.07 kg · app 4.39 kg — the app is 1.32 kg higher (43%). Both are RAW purchase weight, compared like for like. The app now wants MORE than the sheet. Orzo is 220 g per portion in the app across its dishes — worth checking that against the pack.

items.title: Red Peppers, diced
items.evidence: Sheet 5.32 kg · app 7.51 kg — the app is 2.19 kg higher (41%). Both are RAW purchase weight, compared like for like. The app was 4 kg short here before today. Confirming the two Roasted Red Peppers links pushed it past the sheet instead. Either one of those ratios is too high, or the sheet is short.

items.title: Cauliflower Florets IQF
items.evidence: Sheet 3.1 kg · app 2.14 kg — the app is 0.96 kg lower (31%). Both are RAW purchase weight, compared like for like. Two dishes now draw on Cauliflower Florets, Steamed after today's links. Still about a kilo under the sheet.

items.title: Green Beans
items.evidence: Sheet 6.07 kg · app 4.3 kg — the app is 1.77 kg lower (29%). Both are RAW purchase weight, compared like for like. Unchanged by today's work — the app has been steady at 4.3 kg. 1.8 kg under.

items.title: Peas
items.evidence: Sheet 2.36 kg · app 2.87 kg — the app is 0.51 kg higher (22%). Both are RAW purchase weight, compared like for like. App slightly over. Peas appear both as a steamed prep and inside mixes; possible double count.

items.title: Kale IQF
items.evidence: Sheet 11.35 kg · app 9.19 kg — the app is 2.16 kg lower (19%). Both are RAW purchase weight, compared like for like. App about 2 kg under. Kale appears in several mixes as well as the steamed prep.

items.title: Baby Corn
items.evidence: Sheet 0.615 kg · app 0.5 kg — the app is 0.11 kg lower (19%). Both are RAW purchase weight, compared like for like. Almost certainly the six Simmer top-ups on SKU 65, which the D2C import does not take — the same cause as the Thai Green Curry line. Confirm and this one closes.

items.title: Courgette
items.evidence: Sheet 0.36 kg · app 0.5 kg — the app is 0.14 kg higher (38%). Both are RAW purchase weight, compared like for like. Two recipes were linked to “Courgette, Sliced” today (Thai Green Curry and Aubergine chermoula). Worth a look at that recipe too: it is named for slicing but carries pomace oil and salt at a 1.7 yield, which reads more like a roast than a slice.

items.title: Vermicelli Glass Noodles, Cooked
items.evidence: “Vermicelli Glass Noodles, Cooked” is being ordered as if you buy it ready-made — 5.89 kg goes onto the raw-materials list under that name. It is used in “Vermicelli in BBQ Sauce, 39”. The name says it has already been cooked or mixed, so there should be a prep behind it, but no recipe exists. Either it really is bought in that state, or a short recipe needs writing.

items.title: Prep sheets are printing the wrong instructions
items.evidence: The method text on many recipes is contaminated by copy-paste from the workbook, and it prints on the sheets the kitchen works from. Baby Corn's method describes slicing aubergine. Gnocchi says add quinoa and water. Panga Fish says “lay the cod out”. Black Beans, Couscous and Tofu all read “divide marinade equally by number of trays with chicken meat”. Quantities are unaffected — but the written instructions are wrong on the page. Worth its own pass once the editor exists.
